phase.objective: Make the single-phone HIL path safe, deterministic, and honest for supervised agent automation before changing guest/runtime semantics.
entryCriteria: The existing tests/hil runner remains the sole physical-device path.
No physical gate is promoted merely by implementing this phase.
exitCriteria: Concurrent agents cannot mutate the same configured phone.
Destructive HIL actions require explicit expiring local authorization.
Diagnostic evidence is permanently distinct from clean candidate evidence.
Local artifact sets can be verified and uploaded through the real Host API.
Candidate evidence records exact profile, image, desired-state, commit, and APK identities.
Repository root and active-phase metadata cannot silently drift.
The larger guest-class and OCI decisions are recorded without entering implementation scope.
